title: Umgxothwa wethole legolide
intro: Umntu okhankanywe kwiQuran wakhokelela isihlwele esikhulu ekuphambukeni ngexesha lokungabikho komprofeti ohloniphekileyo. Into eyenziwe ngegolide yathimba iintliziyo zesizwe sonke - kodwa ibali lalo mntu liphela ngokuba wedwa nesiqalekiso esingaqhelekanga. Ngubani lo mntu ugxothiweyo?
clues: Ndaphuma ngexesha lokungabikho komprofeti omkhulu owayenyukile ukuze afumane ulwalathiso lukaThixo.
Ndibangele ukuba isihlwele esikhulu siphambuke ngento endiyenzileyo ngezandla zam.
Indalo yegolide endayivelisayo yayibonakala ngathi inobomi, ivelisa izandi ezazibamangalisa abo bayilandelayo.
Ndithi ndibone into abanye abantu abangayiboniyo—ukubona into engabonakaliyo.
Ndakhupha into ethile kwimizila yesithunywa sikaThixo ndayiphosa kwisinyithi esinyibilikisiweyo.
Ndagwetyelwa ukuzulazula ndedwa, ndinesiqalekiso esikhethekileyo sokuba akukho mntu unokuchukumisa ulusu lwam kwaye nam ndingachukumisi olwabo.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Ukugxothwa, ukungavunyelwa ukuba kuchukunyiswe okanye kuchukunyiswe abanye
outcome.answer: Ukugxothwa, ukungavunyelwa ukuba kuchukunyiswe okanye kuchukunyiswe abanye

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
